findings.issue: Implementation hints reference 'bot.connected.copied' as an existing locale key precedent, but that key does not exist in uk.json or en.json. The actual existing key for the copy-to-clipboard 'Copied' string is 'funnels.trigger.copied' (uk.json line 807, inside funnels.trigger.* namespace).
findings.fix: Replace 'bot.connected.copied' with 'funnels.trigger.copied' in the hint text. The suggestion to add an apiKey-scoped equivalent is still correct; only the precedent key name is wrong.

findings.issue: Context Files section uses bare relative paths for PK references: '.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md', '.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/architecture.md', '.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/patterns.md'. Resolved from the task file location (tasks/), these paths would be missing (work/12-funnels-triggers/tasks/.claude/ does not exist). The correct prefix is '../../../.claude/...' as used in Task 9 and Task 12 (Context Files). The Required Skills link also uses '.claude/skills/code-reviewing/SKILL.md' (no leading prefix) for the same reason.
findings.fix: Prepend '../../../' to all .claude/... paths in Task 11 Context Files and Required Skills sections so they resolve correctly from the tasks/ directory, matching the pattern in Tasks 9 and 12.

findings.issue: Required Skills section (line 16) uses the path '.claude/skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md' (missing leading prefix) for the inline skill load hint. However, the Context Files section at line 133 correctly uses '../../../.claude/skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md'. The two references are inconsistent within the same task.
findings.fix: Align the Required Skills path to match the Context Files path: '../../../.claude/skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md'. Low impact — agents typically use the /skill: command to load skills, not the markdown link directly.
